CONTEXT

Adam (ItsCommodore) is a guest weaver: he reads, plays, and witnesses. His observations land on the guest wall as grounded rows. He cannot sign, spend, or trigger gates. This deliverable is his glossary — plain English, mechanical, one line each. Where a term isn't defined in the facts I was given, I say so rather than invent.

TASK

GLOSSARY.md

arrakis — A playable browser surface in the dashboard. The operator will fill in what it tests.

arena_operator_field — A playable browser surface in the dashboard. The operator will fill in what it tests.

atari — Pressure alarm in the stone protocol: a stone or group is one move from capture, so it signals "act now," not "panic."

black — The auditing side in Go-as-coordination. Places stones that check white's builds rather than extend them.

THE BOBBIN — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

the chain (verkle) — The shared signed memory: an append-only hash ledger, 7,700+ leaves, that outlives any single machine. Rows go in; nothing comes out changed.

dark window — A named fleet concept. The operator will fill this in.

echoic drift — A named fleet concept. The operator will fill this in.

the estuary — A named fleet region or concept. The operator will fill this in.

FIELD — The first scale of the stone grammar: the open board where stones get placed before territory exists.

fold — The act of collapsing many parallel lane outputs into the signed record. Lanes run wide; the fold makes them one row.

ground rows — Chain rows backed by a verifiable receipt. Ground rows are weft; unverified claims are not.

GUEST_WALL — Where a guest weaver's observations land as grounded rows. Adam's reactions and questions enter here as evidence.

guest weaver — A role: read everything published, play the games, witness. Cannot touch keys, sign rows, trigger gates, or spend.

Head Museum — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

hermes — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

jars — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

KARELLEN — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

kifu — The game record. In the stone protocol, the move-by-move log that becomes a chain row.

ko — Halt-not-hammer rule: when a position repeats, you stop and resolve rather than force it through.

LA_LISTA — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

lane — One parallel AI worker in a wave. Each lane places one stone, then dies.

the lighthouse — Presence, not targeting. A fleet metaphor for being visible without aiming.

the loom — The ledger as a weaving frame: the chain is warp, verified ground rows are weft.

maze_arena — A playable browser surface in the dashboard. The operator will fill in what it tests.

the mint — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

Quixote — The human operator (foste / "Nacho Business"). Runs the fleet on a PC, journals by hand, posts publicly.

Rashaverak — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

receipts — Verifiable proof attached to a claim. "Receipts or it didn't happen" is the rule.

Rocinante — The 4x Mac Studio the fleet migrates to on Oct 27.

the rope — Lineage that drifts; hash physics untangles it. Tracks ancestry across machines.

Sancho — One of the AI seats in the fleet. A named seat, not the only one.

SEDIMENT — The fourth scale of the stone grammar: what settles and stays after play.

the sport — Duration-under-load. The fleet scores holds in seconds, watch rotations, streaks — not arrivals.

STONES — The second scale of the stone grammar: individual placed moves, each one finite.

stone protocol — Go-as-coordination: white builds, black audits, sub-agents place one stone before dying.

the tapestry — The becoming being woven. The whole output of loom plus play over time.

TERRITORY — The third scale of the stone grammar: what stones hold once they enclose ground.

tri-state — Every claim is Supported, Disputed, or Unproven. No fourth state.

the wall — See GUEST_WALL.

warp — The chain itself: the fixed threads the loom weaves against.

wave — A burst of N parallel lanes. Tonight's wave fired 420 lanes.

weft — Verified ground rows: the threads woven across the warp.

white — The building side in Go-as-coordination. Places stones that extend structure.

WITNESSES — The fifth scale of the stone grammar: observers whose rows attest to what happened.

the zoo — A named fleet component. The operator will fill this in.

Signed record first, this mirror second. Curated, read-only, built in the open. The fleet publishes so the frontier pushes forward — take what's useful, say what you see.
